title: Surgical Retrieval, Isolation and In vitro Expansion of Human Anterior Cruciate Ligament-derived Cells for Tissue Engineering Applications
protocol: Administer general anesthesia and pre-operative antibiotics as per institution's protocol to the patient.
Apply tourniquet and inflate 100 mg above systolic blood pressure.
Situate the patient in the supine position.
Make a horizontal anterolateral incision with knee in 30-45° flexion for a 5 mm portal.
Insert the arthroscopic trocar and camera into the suprapatellar pouch at 30°.
Perform a routine diagnostic arthroscopy.
Enter a notch and debride the membranous synovium over the torn ACL.
Use a 4.5 mm shaver and ablator to identify the ACL stump.
Use a duckbill straight bitter to collect multiple specimens from the remaining ACL stump.
Maintain the sample in normal saline in a sterile container.
Send the samples to pathology for decoding and final delivery to the laboratory facility.
Recover patient and perform post-operative care as per institution's protocol.
Transfer the human ACL tissue received from pathology to a Petri dish with sterile saline/PBS.
Mince the tissue using sterile scissors into 1-2 mm³ pieces.
Wash the minced tissue with saline at least 3 times.
Digest the minced tissue with 0.4% Collagenase in DMEM/F-12 (50/50, 1x) medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin for 4-6 hours at 37°C.
Centrifuge the cells at 1,000 x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in the medium after centrifugation.
Wash the cells with the medium for 2-3 times.
Seed and culture the cells in T-25 flasks for 2-3 days.
Maintain the cells at 37°C in DMEM/F-12 (50/50, 1x) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin.
Change the medium when cells show adherence and standard morphology.
Observe the cells using a light microscope after culturing for 2-3 days.
Wash confluent cells with PBS at day 7 (~1.3 X 10^6 cells/flask).
Add Trypsin (0.5 g/L) to the washed cells and incubate them at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Neutralize trypsin by adding medium to suspended cells.
Divide the media-cell mixture between three T-25 flasks.
Wash confluent cells with PBS, add trypsin (0.5 g/L), and resuspend them in freezing medium containing DMSO, FBS, and complete medium in the ratio 1:2:7.
Store cryogenic vials at -80°C if cells will be used within a month; store in liquid nitrogen for longer durations.
Thaw vials in a 37°C water bath for reuse.
Dissolve 1 g of PLAGA in 12 ml dichloromethane.
Vortex the solution for 8 hours at a constant speed of 800 rpm.
Transfer the dissolved solution to a glass Petri dish lined with Fluorinated protection paper.
Place the Petri dish under a vacuum hood for 30 minutes.
Leave the Petri dish at -20 °C overnight, then transfer it to room temperature.
Place the Petri dishes in a lyophilizer until complete evaporation of the solvent is achieved.
Place the polymer films in a desiccator for 24 hours.
Cut the polymer films into 12 mm diameter circular disks.
Store the polymer disks in a desiccator until needed.
Wash cells (50,000 cells/disk) seeded on control TCPS and PLAGA scaffold with PBS after 7 days of seeding.
Fix the washed cells using 1.5% Glutaraldehyde in 0.1 M Cacodylate buffer.
Post-fix the fixed cells with 2.5% OsO4 in 0.1 M Cacodylate buffer.
Wash the post-fixed cells with 0.1 M Cacodylate buffer.
Dry the fixed cells using serial ethanol dehydration (50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, and 100%) for 15 minutes each.
Further dry the samples in Hexamethyldisilazane overnight.
Vent the chamber of SEM sputter coating system with a button valve.
Raise the top plate to place dried samples in the chamber.
Lower the top plate after placing the samples.
Switch the control knob to pump to start evacuating the chamber.
Open argon leak valve.
Wait for the vacuum to drop to 0.05 mbar.
Coat the dried samples with a thin layer (0.13 nm) of Gold/Palladium.
Return the argon leak valve to its closed position.
Switch the control knob to off.
Vent the chamber with button valve and raise the top plate.
Remove the samples and store them in a desiccator for 24 hr.
Observe the samples under an scanning electron microscope.
Wash the cells (50,000 cells/disk) seeded on the control TCPS and the PLAGA scaffold with PBS 7 days subsequent to seeding.
Fix the cells using 70% ethanol (cold) for 10 min.
Incubate the fixed cells at room temperature with 1% Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA) in PBS having 0.05% Triton X-100 for 20 min.
Immerse the samples in 1% Tween at room temperature for 20 min.
Add monoclonal mouse Anti-β-actin antibody (1:400) and incubate the cells overnight at 4 °C.
Wash the cells with 0.05% Tween.
Add secondary antibody (goat anti-mouse F (ab') 2 fragment of IgG conjugated with a fluorescence probe, 1:400) to the cells and incubate for 1 hr at room temperature.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Stain the cells with nuclear stain and mount using 80% Glycerol.
Observe the cells under a confocal microscope.
